_comment: Переделка картинок одиннадцатой партии: где сцена вышла нечитаемой или в кадр залез текст.
perna: a close-up of one single bare human leg standing straight, seen from the side from the thigh down to the ankle, filling the frame vertically against a plain light studio background, only that one leg in the picture
morango: a handful of fresh ripe red strawberries with their green leafy tops, cupped in two open hands, close-up in daylight
vaga: one empty marked-out parking bay between two parked cars in a car park, the vacant space right in the middle of the frame, photographed at eye level
cumprido: a hand holding a pen and drawing the final green tick into the last of a column of square check boxes, every box above it already ticked, the sheet completely blank apart from the boxes and the ticks, no writing anywhere
tive: a man standing alone in an empty garage holding one old car key up in his open palm, an oil stain on the bare concrete floor where the car used to stand, the car gone
